subject: Private offer: Starlake entitlement mapping & channel margin questions
messages:
From: Marco Silva <marco@starlake.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@starlake.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer for Starlake — baseline ask and channel reseller mapping

Jordan — thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to get a clean private offer so we can onboard BrightEdge (our reseller) as the channel for US enterprise deals. Two quick asks to move forward:

1) Can you confirm how the private-offer list price maps to a reseller passback/commission (we typically need a clear % or dollar passback per SKU)?
2) We need entitlement mapping so our reseller can invoice and enable seats correctly — specifically around reserved capacity vs metered consumption.

I've attached our standard SOW and the high-level procurement checklist. If you can send the private-offer template and a hypothetical margin split (or a couple of options) we can fast-track legal + procurement.

Thanks,
Marco Silva
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Starlake AI
Attachment: Starlake_MA-1.2.pdf (PDF)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marco Silva <marco@starlake.ai>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer for Starlake — baseline ask and channel reseller mapping

Marco — appreciate the clarity. Looping in Camila (deal ops) and Ben (pricing) so we can propose two well-scoped options. High level from my side:

- Option A (standard passback): flat 18% of net list for reseller (applies to reserved SKU families only).
- Option B (hybrid): 12% on reserved + 20% on metered overage credits (gives reseller uplift on variable consumption).

Can you confirm BrightEdge will be the named reseller on the PO and whether they require a reseller-specific SKU (some marketplaces require a distributor mapping)? If you can confirm those two points I’ll ask Camila/Ben to produce a short matrix (SKU -> passback % -> entitlement label).

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer for Starlake — baseline ask and channel reseller mapping

Team — reviewed Marco's attachments and Starlake's billing model. Drafted an SKU mapping and two-margin scenarios (attached pricing_model_v2.csv). Notes:

- Reserved SKU families (rdw-reserved-small/med/large): recommend 15% passback under a three-year commit (retains a buffer for listprice anchoring).
- Metered compute/embedding SKU (rdw-embed-tx): recommend 18% on pre-committed baseline and 25% on true overage reconciliation.
- Entitlement labels: we will publish three entitlement tags for BrightEdge invoices: RESERVED-STD, RESERVED-COMMIT-3Y, METER-OVERAGE. This keeps invoicing unambiguous.

Operational asks from procurement side: we need the reseller legal name and their billing email to populate the private offer. Marco, can you provide BrightEdge's legal name and invoice contact?

Attachment: pricing_model_v2.csv (CSV)

Camila Reyes
Deal Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marco Silva <marco@starlake.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@starlake.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer for Starlake — baseline ask and channel reseller mapping

Thanks Camila — BrightEdge legal name is BrightEdge, Inc. and billing contact is invoices@brightedge.com. Two clarifications from procurement:

- They want to ensure the passback is not classified as a discount on Starlake's side (procurement rules that out for tax reasons). Can Redwood issue the passback as a reseller commission or voucher to BrightEdge?
- For RESERVED-COMMIT-3Y, our legal needs a line that ensures early termination clawback applies pro rata if commitment is not met. Is that standard for Redwood private-offer templates?

We can do a 30-minute call Monday to walk through the matrix and get a redline going.

Marco

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marco Silva <marco@starlake.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer for Starlake — baseline ask and channel reseller mapping

Marco — quick answers and next steps.

1) Tax/treatment: We do not record the reseller passback as a customer-facing discount. We typically structure it as a third-party commission to the reseller (BrightEdge) in our partner ledger and it is invoiced to BrightEdge as a commission settlement. I’ll coordinate with finance to confirm accounting flows but this is standard.

2) Early termination/clawback: yes — our private-offer template supports a pro-rata clawback clause for multi-year commits. We’ll add a short, billable reconciliation appendix (example language below):

   "If cumulative paid consumption for RESERVED-COMMIT-3Y is less than the committed minimum at the time of termination, Customer will remit the pro-rata shortfall to Redwood within 30 days following termination unless otherwise agreed in writing."

3) Next steps: I uploaded a redlined example of the private offer and an internal summary to the HubSpot deal (link above). Marco — can you confirm the PO/reseller fields are acceptable and we’ll send DocuSign with the private-offer attachment by EOD Monday. If helpful, Jordan can set the 30-minute call Monday 10am PT.

Ben Carter
Pricing & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment referenced: private_offer_draft_for_STK-041.docx (uploaded to related link)
